name: Pups Everywhere
description:
Have you ever wondered why there are no pups in [b]all campaigns or expeditions[/b]? Well, now there are! This mod adds pups to all campaigns and expeditions with some nice configurable features.

Try [b]customizing it to make spawns lots of pups[/b] in the region xD, or cap the amount of pups to spawn in every cycle if you want a constant amount of pups to spawn every cycle. 

Checkout the [b]collection[/b] i've created it can make even funnier to play with.

 With translation to all game supported languages.

[i]Pinterest artist: Karma_De45.[/i]
